prejudge.definition: v. judge beforehand, especially without sufficient evidence
prejudge.translation: vt. 预先判断, 对...预先作出判决

prejudged.translation: v. 预先判断( prejudge的过去式和过去分词 )

prejudgement.definition: n a judgment reached before the evidence is available
prejudgement.translation: n. 在审判前判决；预先判断, 预断

prejudges.definition: v judge beforehand, especially without sufficient evidence
prejudges.translation: v. 预先判断( prejudge的第三人称单数 )

prejudging.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Prejudge
prejudging.translation: v. 预先判断( prejudge的现在分词 )

prejudgment.definition: n. a judgment reached before the evidence is available
prejudgment.translation:
n. 预先判断, 不审而判, 过早判断
[法] 未经审迅的判决, 预断, 臆断

prejudgments.definition: n a judgment reached before the evidence is available
prejudgments.translation: n. 预先判断；过早判断；不审而判

prejudication.definition:
n. The act of prejudicating, or of judging without due
   examination of facts and evidence; prejudgment.
n. A preliminary inquiry and determination about
   something which belongs to a matter in dispute.
n. A previous treatment and decision of a point; a
   precedent.
prejudication.translation:
n. 预先判断, 预先判决
[法] 预先判决, 判例

prejudice.definition:
v. disadvantage by prejudice
v. influence (somebody's) opinion in advance
prejudice.translation:
n. 偏见, 成见, 侵害
vt. 使存偏见, 使有成见, 侵害

prejudiced.definition:
s. emanating from a person's emotions and prejudices
a. being biased or having a belief or attitude formed beforehand

prejudices.definition:
n a partiality that prevents objective consideration of an issue or situation
v disadvantage by prejudice
v influence (somebody's) opinion in advance
prejudices.translation: n. 成见, 偏见, 歧视( prejudice的名词复数 )

prejudicial.definition: a. tending to favor preconceived ideas
prejudicial.translation:
a. 造成偏见的, 有侵害的
[法] 有损害的, 不利的, 有偏见的

prejudicing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Prejudice
prejudicing.translation:
n. 偏见；侵害
vt. 损害；使有偏见

prejudicious.definition:
a tending to favor preconceived ideas
s (sometimes followed by `to') causing harm or injury
prejudicious.translation: a. 不利的, 有损害的,有侵害的
